relevance_note: In a 15-subject cohort of children with recurrent aphthous stomatitis and systemic inflammation, one patient has a TNFAIP3 variant, as the authors state: "1 TNFAIP3 mutation (A20 haploinsufficiency, #15 with BD)", and his mother is also described as carrying the A20 mutation.
method_note: Worked directly from the Markdown full text (main text plus the two converted supplementary files); no script transcribed any table. Scope: only patient #15 carries a TNFAIP3 variant / HA20 diagnosis; the other 14 enrolled patients (#1-#14) have no TNFAIP3 variant and no HA20 diagnosis, so they get no rows and are counted only in publications.cohort_size_as_stated (15). Their relatives (e.g. the mother of #5, the mother of #9) are therefore also out of scope. Two relatives of #15 are in scope as affected relatives: his mother ('the patient #15 mother, also carrying the A20 mutation, was also affected with BD') and his grandmother (familial history 'BD (mother grandmother)'; 'a treatment with adalimumab is being considered for the grandmother, who presents complaints similar to the nephew'). The grandmother is not stated to carry the variant, so she has no variant row. The mother's variant description (c.C1135T p.Q379X) is taken from Table 2 row #15, whose 'STATUS (carrier)' cell is 'HZ(mother)', together with the sentence saying she carries the A20 mutation; because D-29 forbids transferring a person's variant details to a relative, her zygosity, inheritance, pathogenicity, variant type, ACMG and functional evidence are 'not reported'. The transcript NM_001270508 is printed in the Patients and methods gene list ('TNFAIP3 (NM_001270508 → NP_001257437)') and the Table 2 note states the 'variant' column 'refer[s] to the coordinates of the gene transcript reported in the materials and methods'. Table 1 has no stacked (' / ') cells in row #15; the ' / ' in Additional file 1 Table S1 separates each value from its normal range and was not read positionally. Table 1 legend defines '-' as negative result and 'N' as normal, so HLA B51, pathergy and immunophenotype cells for #15 are recorded as excluded features ('positive HLA B51', 'positive pathergy test', 'normal immunophenotype'); the immunophenotype cell is a whole normal investigation and names no specific abnormality (see D-27). Table 1 lists the diagnosis of #15 as 'BD' while the text says the diagnosis was changed to A20 haploinsufficiency after genetic testing; this is recorded as the disease label, not as a contradiction. 'cites_prior_report_of_same_patients' is false: the paper reports no earlier description of its own patients (only a previously reported mutation, p.T288A in #10), and no span exists for that negative statement, so its span is null. checklist_feature names are taken from the schema; 'skin lesions (rash, folliculitis, erythema nodosum)' is marked observed for #15 on the basis of 'skin abscesses'. Two judgement calls: (1) 'perianal ulcerations' in #15 was not counted as the checklist item 'gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation' (not reported), because the paper never names that item for him; (2) 'oral ulcers' for #15 is supported by the group sentence 'Recurrent aphthous stomatitis was a presenting symptom in all patients', which names the group, so it is marked observed with evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'.
